parsed.post: Discarding 0.8588 (slightly worse than 0.8584). The lower MATRIX_LR=0.04 didn't provide immediate benefit in this run. I will now try adding WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 to my best config to see if regularization helps stabilize the 6-layer architecture during convergence.
parsed.description: Adding WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 to the previous best configuration (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.04, WARMUP_RATIO=0.15) to improve generalization.
